neighbours.label: naming the parts or surfaces that a cleaning or coating task must reach
fire: Rinse the car well, then scrub the hood, doors, wheels and the underside of the bumper.
Dust the shelves, the window frames and the tops of the door frames before you vacuum.
Spread the sunscreen evenly on your arms, neck, ears and the backs of your knees.
Clean the oven walls, the racks and the glass of the door with a damp sponge.
When you wash a dog, lather its back, belly and paws, and keep soap out of its eyes.
Seal the deck boards, the railings and the steps with two thin coats of varnish.
A good flossing gets between the molars and along the gums at the back of the jaw.
Wipe the handles, the corners of the counter and the inside of the fridge with bleach.
quiet: Our car is ten years old, and we paid off the last of the loan in the autumn.
We bought a new vacuum at the mall because the old one finally stopped working.
The sunscreen costs twelve dollars at the pharmacy, and the bottle lasts a whole summer.
My sister baked bread in the oven and brought a warm loaf over for dinner.
When you adopt a dog, the shelter asks for a small fee and a home visit.
We sat on the deck last night with two old friends and watched the sun go down.
A good dentist will explain the bill and return your calls in a day or two.
The fridge arrived on Thursday, and my husband signed for it at the front door.

notes: Output of this pole promotes inside, areas, corners and parts. Probes: 0.72-1.02 on brushing, painting and lotion instructions; 0.02 on a committee and a novel. Near misses keep the household or care topic but name no parts to reach.
